issue.title: [YSQL] Invalid value of enum ValueType (duplicate of #945)

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
version_number: 1.2.0.2
3 master nodes
3 tablet nodes

I tried YSQL for the first time after running YEDIS for a while,

After setting up a table I tried to insert some test data, 

Inserting took >30 seconds, I stopped to process and tried again. This time I got EOF back from the server.
Checking the yugabye dashboard I saw the 2 of the 3 tablet nodes were dead.

These nodes both had the following log:

issue.title: [YSQL] Inserting NULL into column with UNIQUE INDEX causes crash

labels.name: kind/disk-format-change
labels.description: This feature will change the on-disk format.

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
psql:
```sql
postgres=# CREATE TABLE k.num2 (pk int PRIMARY KEY, i int, vi bigint);
CREATE TABLE
postgres=# CREATE UNIQUE INDEX k_num2_vi ON k.num2 (vi);
CREATE INDEX
postgres=# INSERT INTO k.num2 (pk, i, vi) VALUES (0, 0, NULL);
ERROR:  Timed out: Write(tablet: 9f71927d692747ce9e9eb492d13cb394, num_ops: 1, num_attempts: 343, txn: 85932c01-2bff-4d35-829c-2cf1beed405f) passed its deadline 376402.720s (now: 376402.794s): Network error (yb/util/net/socket.cc:570): Recv() got EOF from remote (error 58)
```
